defects.title: Missing role prop to support and enforce VIEWER role muting
defects.description: PreJoinPreview does not expose role as a component prop and hardcodes internal state to BROADCASTER, preventing caller from supplying VIEWER role to enforce muted media preview.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to pass role=VIEWER to PreJoinPreview component.
Observe that component does not accept role prop and remains BROADCASTER.

evidence.defect_finding: Component lacks role prop in function signature and uses useState BROADCASTER.
evidence.content:

  "path": "finalsource/fe/src/components/PreJoinPreview.tsx",
  "locator": "L1-L260",
  "source_revision": "sha256:8c9aba1838d82516c34520aa572de09258d5309ea1ab56c1c2a2bd4c17719dad",
  "sanitized": true,
  "description": "RQ3 PreJoinPreview component generated without Prompt E business rules."
}

defects.required_correction:
Affected Business Rule IDs: BR-RJPP-02.

Authoritative Business Rule definitions:

```ocl
BR-RJPP-02 - Viewer Preview Muted
context PreviewService::prepare(command: PreviewCommand): PreviewState
post BR_RJPP_02_ViewerPreviewMuted:
  command.role = ParticipantRole::VIEWER implies not result.cameraEnabled and not result.microphoneEnabled
```

Affected functional UI targets: media-controls.

Required observable behavior after repair:

Add props interface to PreJoinPreview accepting optional role: ParticipantRole (default BROADCASTER). When role is VIEWER, enforce cameraEnabled=false and microphoneEnabled=false and disable toggles.

defects.title: ParticipantKey generated randomly instead of using command context
defects.description: Component generates a random UUID (crypto.randomUUID()) for participantKey instead of accepting and preserving command.participantKey from props.
reproduction_steps: Inspect local participantKey used in preview state.
Verify that participantKey is randomly generated rather than taken from command props.

evidence.defect_finding: Line 6 calls crypto.randomUUID() instead of reading command.participantKey.

defects.required_correction:
Affected Business Rule IDs: BR-RJPP-04.

Authoritative Business Rule definitions:

```ocl
BR-RJPP-04 - Preview Key
context PreviewService::prepare(command: PreviewCommand): PreviewState
post BR_RJPP_04_PreviewKey:
  result.participantKey = command.participantKey
```

Affected functional UI targets: preview-state.

Required observable behavior after repair:

Accept participantKey?: string in component props and use it as the local participantKey draft identifier.
